purpose: User-authorized fixed paper-informed ensembles, optional research tropism and gap assessment; no observed-data fitting or physiological adoption
alignment_sensitivity_warning: 0 cm base is a nonphysiological alignment sensitivity, never a preferred fit or measured planting depth

observation.boundary_rule: floor in positive-depth coordinates; half-open cubes
observation.invalid: exclude invalid child edges and report their length
observation.outside_prism: unobserved; report overflow, no exterior penalty
observation.classes: observed polyline labels versus generated integer orders are an unqualified operational proxy
observation.soil_boundary: legacy at model base; fichtl_tropism surface_z=20 above the base. Primary comparison depth=20-z_sim.

mapping_assumptions.uniform_length_bounds: mean +/- sqrt(3)*between-vine SD used as per-organ proxy; not a verified organ distribution
mapping_assumptions.length_reduction: 8.9/40.3; daughter nominal mean = 40.3/length_reduction, before parent-segment increments
mapping_assumptions.root_counts: 4 outer + 5 inner; secondary requested cap 2..3; growth_sec_root .35 is a count-ratio engineering approximation
mapping_assumptions.global_spacing: paper_proxy 4.8 cm; branching_capacity .75 cm tests global-capacity limitation, with no claim it is a measured initial-root spacing
mapping_assumptions.maximum_order: 3 for paper proxies; unrepresented higher labels remain a reported gap
mapping_assumptions.gravity: .1 diagnostic blend; never substituted from paper probability .65
mapping_assumptions.diameter: base .36 cm, apex .05 cm, reduction .2 are nuisance visual inputs; no mass validation
mapping_assumptions.fichtl_tropism: Same count/length/spacing inputs as branching_capacity; keep generated initial roots, use paper-angle truncated-normal proxies and per-segment gravity/plagiotropism search; surface20cm above base and no forced downward lateral apex. These mechanism changes are combined, not individually identified. Legacy gravitropism is explicitly zero; no post-tropism rotation is permitted. Only orders1-3 are supported.
mapping_assumptions.angles: Printed radians corrected to degrees following author estimator; clipped-by-rejection normal in[0,90] is an explicit distribution approximation

evaluation.design: All eight SO4/T2 vines are descriptive comparisons; no train/holdout or independent generalization claim
evaluation.normalization: pooled positive SO4/T2 RLD q75 with numpy method linear; physical RLD units
evaluation.loss: .5 occupied-cell MAE + .5 digitized-zero-cell MAE, divided by q75; also physical MAE and length coverage
evaluation.representative: median valid-soil length rank with seed or vine ID tie-break, never best observed fit
evaluation.aggregate_validation: Paper-informed quantities are setup checks, not independent validation
